scope: Read-only audit of the current local market-data profile, installed capability paths, and retained local archives. No live market fetch, credential inspection beyond presence checks, procurement, configuration change, or external action occurred.

route_matrix.hard_limit: Forward-adjusted or unknown price basis and no approved point-in-time universe, corporate-action/event, known-at/revision, or validated execution ledger.
Forward-adjusted daily bars only; no governance-approved point-in-time, action, known-at/revision, or execution data package.
Integrity proves retained bytes, not source completeness. Public replay inputs explicitly leave actions, halts, limits, delistings, and price basis unverified.

Requires an authorized licensed-data profile, provider credential, data-owner attestation, and package. Even then, the implementation lacks a complete known-at/revision model and full execution evidence.
Requires authorized credentials and attestation; implemented output is minute OHLCV only and expressly does not establish queue or fill evidence.
Registry reference only; no local market-data adapter is implemented.

formal_gaps: rights-cleared point-in-time investable universe, including inactive, renamed, suspended, risk-warning, and delisted instruments
complete corporate-action, distribution, rights, merger, spin-off, delisting, restatement, and total-return treatment
published-at, available-at, revision/version, raw-object hash, and retention/replay rights for every historical decision input
decision-time quote/depth/status/limit/no-fill, fee/tax/settlement, and product or broker eligibility records
independent reconstruction and forward paper-observation evidence

decision.why: The local public-observation routes are useful for hypothesis exploration only. No current route closes the combined point-in-time, total-return, availability/revision, and execution evidence gates needed to turn a historical result into a usable-strategy conclusion.
decision.next_verification_path: Only after the user authorizes an appropriately licensed data route and its written usage rights can a source acceptance review determine whether a newly frozen historical or forward research protocol is allowed. This audit neither requests nor authorizes such procurement.

boundary: This is a local capability audit, not a product selection, a strategy recommendation, a performance forecast, or an instruction to take any external action.
